message.entity-rush.lan_blocked: Entity Rush does not work in LAN mode
option.entity-rush.countdown_sound.toolt: Play a sound on each "X seconds left" message (not on the join message)
option.entity-rush.enable_world_override: When on, this world uses the settings below instead of the global ones; when off it just follows global
option.entity-rush.list_mode.tooltip: Off = category toggles (friendly/neutral/hostile/non-mob); On = entity list (whitelist/blacklist)
option.entity-rush.module_enabled.toolti: When off, the timer freezes: no teleports, sounds or messages. Turning it back on takes effect immediately.
option.entity-rush.show_countdown.toolti: Show the "X seconds left" countdown in chat
option.entity-rush.show_remaining_on_joi: Show the time until the next teleport when joining a world (no sound)
option.entity-rush.show_teleport_message: Show a chat message and play the teleport sound when a teleport happens
option.entity-rush.sound_over_10.tooltip: Played on each "X seconds left" message while X is above 10
option.entity-rush.sound_teleport.toolti: Played when entities are teleported (requires "Teleport Message")
option.entity-rush.sound_within_10.toolt: Played every second during the last 10 seconds (X is 10 or less)
option.entity-rush.tp_entity_list.toolti: Entity ids used in list mode, one per line (e.g. skeleton, pig); autocompletes while typing
option.entity-rush.tp_friendly.tooltip: Category mode: include friendly mobs (pigs, cows, sheep, ...)
option.entity-rush.tp_hostile.tooltip: Category mode: include hostile mobs (zombies, skeletons, creepers, ...)
option.entity-rush.tp_neutral.tooltip: Category mode: include neutral mobs (endermen, spiders, wolves, ...)
option.entity-rush.tp_non_entity.tooltip: Category mode: include non-mob entities (minecarts, dropped items, projectiles, ...)
option.entity-rush.tp_use_whitelist.tool: List mode: On = whitelist (only listed entities), Off = blacklist (exclude listed entities)
text.entity-rush.config.title: Entity Rush Config
text.entity-rush.error.empty_cell: The list entry cannot be empty
text.entity-rush.error.empty_list: There is an empty entry; fill it in or remove it
text.entity-rush.multiplayer: This is a multiplayer game; per-world settings are singleplayer only.
text.entity-rush.no_modmenu: Mod Menu is not installed, so the config has no entry in the mod list. Press %s to open the Entity Rush config; you can change this key in Key Binds.
text.entity-rush.no_world: Not in a world yet; per-world settings are unavailable.
text.entity-rush.world_override_hint: Changes here do not affect this world; see the "Current World" tab
text.entity-rush.world_override_warning: ⚠ This world has its own settings enabled
